---
output:
  whesApp::report
params:
  lang: NA
  title: NA
  author: NA
  date: NA
  conditions: NA
  info: NA
urlcolor: blue

title: "`r params$title`"
author: "`r params$author`"
date: "`r params$date`"
---

```{r setup, echo = FALSE}
library("whesApp")
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
economics = "economics" %in% params$info
policy = "policy" %in% params$info
evidence = "evidence" %in% params$info
needs = "needs" %in% params$info
solutions = "solutions" %in% params$info
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
cat("\n\n\\pagebreak\n")
```
